title: plan summary
description: The grouped plan summary (#3188): a change-set document's members, or one member's instances, grouped by their normalized changes, with every destroy, replacement, failure and hole by name. Written by `chant change-set summary --format json` and by groupChangeSet in @intentius/chant/plan-summary. Reviewers read it; no gate binds it. Version 1 of the workspace read contract. Readers ignore fields they do not know; a field is only ever added within a version.

changeSet.description: The digest of the change-set document summarized.

unit.description: member: each unit is a member of the document. instance: each unit is one resource instance of the document's one member.

units.description: Members, failed ones included, or the changing instances.

groups.description: Largest first. For instances, sorted by resource first.

failed.description: Members that failed to plan. None is in a group.

destroys.description: Every delete and replace in the document, failed members' included, sorted by member and address.

holes.description: Every address a member's planner could not read.

line.description: The action's symbol, the normalized address and, for an update or replace, the attributes it writes. Values are never printed.

count.description: How many times one unit makes this change.

differsFrom.description: The baseline group whose change at the same address and action this one differs from.

id.description: Twelve hex characters of computePlanDigest("plan-summary-group", { resource, changes }) over the group's sorted normalized changes. The same change gets the same id in every run, so a report can link one group across commits. A change to the normalization rules can change it.

resource.description: For instance groups, the expansion: the address with its instance keys removed.

units.description: Member names or instance addresses, sorted.

outlier.description: A group of one beside other groups of the same expansion.

extends.description: The group whose whole change this one contains.

plus.description: What it adds to that group's change.

destroys.description: Every delete and replace a unit of this group makes. Each is also in the top-level destroys.
